blurb: Del Valle Marina offers motorboat and patio boat rentals at the East Beach marina area. Kayaks and paddleboards can be rented seasonally at the Kayak Center at the east beach. The marina is located on Lake Del Valle, a five-mile-long lake with various water activities including swimming, windsurfing, and boating.
extraNote: Boat speed limit is 5 mph on the entire lake · Hydrofoils and E-Foils are not permitted on the lake · East Beach marina area, Del Valle Regional Park
